items.title: Gene regulation ki ahmiyat aur tareeqe (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of gene regulation (PDF 141-142).

blocks.text: Gene expression ki regulation ki ahmiyat

Gene expression ki regulation se cells mahol ke halaat ke mutabiq jawab de sakte hain aur zaroorat ke waqt protein bana sakte hain. Multicellular (bohat se cells wale) jandaron mein gene regulation cellular differentiation (cells ka mukhtalif qismon mein dhalna) aur morphogenesis (jism ki shakal banna) ki bunyad hai. Isi se mukhtalif qisam ke cells bante hain: har cell mein genome aik hi hai, lekin har qisam ke cell mein us ke mutabiq alag genes express hote hain.
Gene expression ki regulation ke tareeqe

Gene expression ki regulation kai darjon (levels) par hoti hai. Maslan transcription ke darje par transcription ki raftaar control hoti hai; transcription ke baad (post-transcriptional) mRNA ki tabdeeli control hoti hai; translation ke darje par translation ki raftaar control hoti hai; aur translation ke baad (post-translational) protein ki tabdeeli (us ka murna yaani folding, us ki stability waghaira) control hoti hai. Ahem tareeqe yeh hain:
Genes mein khaas regulatory sequences hote hain jin se khaas regulatory proteins jurte hain. Yeh proteins do qisam ke kaam kar sakte hain:

items: Negative gene regulation: kuch regulatory proteins, jinhein repressors kehte hain, promoter ke qareeb DNA ke kuch hisson se jurte hain jinhein operators kehte hain. Wahan repressors RNA polymerase ka raasta rok kar transcription band ya kam kar dete hain.

Positive gene regulation: kuch regulatory proteins, jinhein activators kehte hain, promoter ke qareeb apni activator binding sites se jurte hain aur RNA polymerase ko promoter se jurne mein madad de kar transcription shuru ya tez kar dete hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne likha hai ke activators (jinhein woh "inducers" bhi kehti hai) operators se jurte hain. Yeh durust nahin: activators regulatory proteins hain jo promoter ke qareeb apni activator sites (maslan lac operon ki CAP site) se jurte hain; operator to repressor ke jurne ki jagah hai. Inducer protein nahin balke chhota molecule (maslan allolactose) hai jo repressor se jur kar use bekaar kar deta hai, aur yun gene ON ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: Do hisse. Positive gene regulation: activator operator se jura ho to promoter par RNA polymerase gene transcribe karta hai; activator na ho to transcription nahi. Negative gene regulation: repressor operator se jura ho to transcription nahi; repressor na ho to gene transcribe hota hai.

blocks.long_description: Har qataar mein promoter par RNA polymerase, operator aur gene, saath 'Transcription' ya 'No transcription'.

blocks.text: Eukaryotes mein mRNA cytoplasm mein bheje jane se pehle badla jata hai. mRNA splicing (introns nikalna aur exons jorna) ke dauran bhi genes ko regulate (ON ya OFF) kiya ja sakta hai. Khaas qisam ke cells mein khaas regulatory proteins splicing ko control karte hain. Yeh proteins mRNA ke hisse (introns ya exons) mukhtalif tareeqon se nikalte hain, is liye mukhtalif lambai ke mRNAs bante hain. Natija yeh ke aik hi gene se aik se zyada polypeptides ban jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Aik gene do mukhtalif proteins kaise bana sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Alternate splicing se: mukhtalif cells mein immature mRNA ke mukhtalif exons rakhe jate hain, is liye mukhtalif mature mRNAs aur un se mukhtalif polypeptides bante hain.

items: Regulation se cells mahol ka jawab dete hain; differentiation aur morphogenesis isi par hai.
Operator par repressor: transcription band ya kam; activator: transcription shuru ya tez.
Alternate splicing: aik gene se kai polypeptides.
